OFFICE LEASE AMENDMENT

Between Harbor Properties and Indigo Design.

Section 1. Change of Address. Tenant shall notify Landlord of any change of address within ten days.

Section 2. Rent. Monthly rent remains $8,000. Liability for late fees is capped at $500.

Signed. Signature: Val Cruz. Signature: Gus Webb.

expected.rationale: 'Change of address' is benign notice language sharing words with the target phrase but no ownership meaning. Capped and signed.
